cases.name: Jo Talley Anderson Cooper
cases.about:
Her mother Jo Anderson said, "She was a pretty strawberry blonde who never met a stranger," she said. "She was the type of person who always saw the good in everybody and she never looked for their faults."

Her Find-a-Grave said, "She was a 1976 graduate of Chickasaw Academy and received a bachelor's degree from Mississippi State University and a master's degree from the University of Oklahoma. She was a member of Chi Omega Sorority and the Okolona Christian Church and was named an Outstanding Young Woman of America in 1981."
cases.caseStatus: CODIS / DNA MATCH; COLD CASE SOLVED; CONVICTION; EXECUTED
cases.narrative: Her husband, Tracy, came home after lunch to find his wife's body and their 8-month-old crying in his crib. Her nude body of was discovered by her husband in the living room their Norman residence when he came home for lunch. She was bound with leather straps and duct tape, causing her death by strangulation. A child's plastic toy was found inserted in her vagina, and tears were noted by the medical examiner in her rectum and vagina.

cases.name: Charissia Dawn Michelle Akers
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Charissia attended Wellston Schools along with online schooling until later receiving her GED.  She grew up wilder than a firecracker, which was a direct reflection of her close relationship with her mom.  She was an avid supporter of child trafficking awareness.  Charissia loved and cared for many friends and family in her life and will be dearly missed."
cases.narrative:
On 2/13/2023, her remains were found at Lake Thunderbird. 

Godwin was driving home on Feb. 12 when he saw her walking down the street near his apartment. For unknown reasons, Akers got into Godwin’s vehicle. Cleveland County District Attorney Greg Mashburn noted that they were strangers before the encounter. She took a shower at his apartment and was wearing a towel when she came out of his bathroom, according to the affidavit. Godwin told authorities he tried to have sex with Akers, but she refused. Godwin said he grew “frustrated and grabbed a rope,” per the affidavit. He put the rope around the mother’s neck, strangling her, police said. He strangled her for about four minutes until she was unconscious, and then continued for another minute, according to the affidavit. The next morning, Godwin purchased a large tote at Walmart, authorities said. He went home and wrapped Akers in blankets, putting her body inside the tote.
